lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in approximately five distinguishable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The nodes within these columns exhibit varied spacing, with the most prominent column containing four distinct centroids aligned along a vertical axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Irregular vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs. These bands are most distinct in the mid-flank region, where they form anchor nodes with the circular blobs, occasionally bifurcating near the dorsal-lateral transition.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with pixel values peaking on the superior edge and dropping into shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in pattern morphology is visible at the first gill slit, shifting from a high-density cluster of micro-spots on the cephalic region to larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
